texts.about.s1.title: creativity
texts.about.s3.cap: based in Sulaymaniyah, Iraq. Dreaming big and making waves since 2020.
texts.about.s4.title: two wild goats
texts.about.s4.p1: Before GOAT was an agency, it was an idea shared between two friends. They were designers and creators who spent years working for other people, and like many creators, they started asking the same question:
texts.about.s4.p2: What if we built something of our own? Not another ordinary agency, but a place where bold ideas could climb higher. So they did what goats do best.
texts.about.s5.title: they climbed
texts.about.s5.p: What started as two minds quickly turned into something bigger: a creative agency built on passion, experimentation and fearless ideas.
texts.about.s6.p1: GOAT was never meant to be a typical office. We built a place where creativity comes first: open desks, shared tables and room to try things. Designers, strategists, storytellers and creators work side by side to push ideas further.
texts.about.s6.p2: Just talented people, great energy and a shared obsession with making things that stand out. From brainstorming sessions to spontaneous creative experiments, our space was designed to inspire, because great work rarely happens in quiet rooms.
texts.about.s8.title: the climb
texts.about.s8.c1: GOAT started to become the greatest advertising agency of all time. First in Iraq. Then across Asia. And eventually the world.
texts.about.s8.c2: We've grown quickly, collaborating with brands across Iraq and beyond, launching campaigns and helping businesses stand out in crowded markets.
texts.about.s9.title: the herd
texts.about.s9.a: At GOAT, we don't just hire talent.
texts.about.s9.b: Skills can be learned. Tools can be mastered. But passion, the kind that keeps you experimenting, improving and pushing ideas further, is what really builds great work.
texts.about.s9.c: Our team is a mix of designers, strategists and creators who genuinely
texts.about.s9.d: Different minds. Different styles. One shared mindset. Create work that stands out.
texts.about.s10.title: trusted by
texts.about.s10.name: Ali Shawkat
texts.about.s10.quote: GOAT is an agency that consistently works hard to deliver results. Their dedication is clear, and they approach each project with genuine effort.
texts.about.s11.hl1: build a brand, launch a campaign
texts.about.s11.c: that lives for creativity, we'd love to hear from you. Because the best ideas don't stay at the bottom.
